name: Bounded Continuation Persistence Proof Obligation Mapping

proof_obligations.name: Bounded Cost Preservation
proof_obligations.must_show: If C_A remains within B_local(alpha), continuation remains admissible under the declared local constraints.

proof_obligations.name: Persistence Metric Coherence
proof_obligations.must_show: P_survival consistently reflects bounded continuation survivability across declared reference models.

proof_obligations.name: Failure Boundary Soundness
proof_obligations.must_show: Each failure class blocks persistence claims rather than being silently absorbed as success.

proof_obligations.name: Reconstruction Divergence Bound
proof_obligations.must_show: Persistence claims require bounded R_divergence and preserve branch ambiguity when uniqueness fails.

proof_obligations.name: Topology Accessibility Requirement
proof_obligations.must_show: T_access must remain nonzero or above declared threshold for persistence continuity to remain admissible.

proof_obligations.name: Identity Continuity Nonprimitivity
proof_obligations.must_show: I_continuity is derived from bounded continuation class behavior, not primitive sameness.

proof_obligations.name: Cross-Mechanism Scope Bound
proof_obligations.must_show: Cross-mechanism alignment supports limited structural robustness but does not imply universal equivalence.
